title: 第3070章 十血俑第十二龛位第3069章 恐怖的黑暗古祖们
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
“轰轰轰！”
洛凡尘瞧得出来，无论是那紫金色的海洋，还是一道道巨大到超乎常人想象的石碑都拥有着能将二十阶强者拒之门外的强大气息。
而在那些巨大的石碑后面，则是一个沐浴在紫金火焰之中的不朽大界，单从气势上看，还要远超炎黄大界和山海大界，显然这不朽长生大界在九维大界之中，应当是一等一的存在了。
熊熊燃烧的紫金火焰后面，隐隐能看到数十尊巨大的大界传人身影，他们或是出身在不朽长生大界，或是收到消息从其他大界匆匆赶来支援的强者。
每一尊能屹立在那里，阻拦黑暗古祖的身影，那都是战胜了侵略家乡的古祖，打破枷锁，冲破重重阻碍的盖世天骄，是惊艳了一方大界的绝世奇才。
然而在大量黑暗古祖的入侵下，他们如今显得极为狼狈。
风祖震撼道：“那是不朽长生界传说中的三重防护手段，紫金长生海，亘古不朽丰碑，还有乾坤灭道极火。”
“三重防护手段霸道至极，纵然只有几十个大界传人催动，也足以抵抗数倍于他们的黑暗古祖。”
洛凡尘颔首，事实的确如此。
他明显能感觉出来，单凭蛮力，他绝无可能突破到那不朽长生界中。
炎黄大界能为他创造出匿因隐果无上仙阵，同样的这不朽长生大界，亦有自己独道的传承手段。
风祖等人都齐刷刷的看向洛凡尘，想知道这血魔教主接下来要做什么。
以他们的眼光看来，这血魔教主在这里根本就没有发挥的空间。
上百个黑暗古祖他应对不了。
这不朽长生大界他更突破不进去。
就算能杀进去，几十个大界传人也不是他能应对的。
洛凡尘舔了舔嘴唇：“要不趁机劫杀几个黑暗古祖好了。”
风祖脸色煞白，劝洛凡尘不要这样做。
“教主。”
“方才看漏了一个黑暗古祖。”

“黑暗天祖第十二龛位的血蜕古祖也在这里。”
洛凡尘询问：“此人有何特殊？”
风祖目光投到了远处，洛凡尘顺着目光看去，那里存在着十个巨大的血茧，坐镇在大后方，明显能发现，一个个气焰嚣张，行为怪异的黑暗古祖根本不敢太靠近那里。
“教主，那十个血茧应当都是传说中的血蜕古祖。”
“传闻这血蜕古祖擅长因果寄生之术，没人知道祂具体是怎么寄生的，只知道很多赫赫有名的黑暗古祖，亦或者是大界强者悄无声息的被寄生了，某一天突然觉醒记忆，发现自己是血蜕古祖。”
“这十尊血茧在这里，怕不是有十尊血蜕古祖寄生的无上之躯存在于此地。”
山海之主和洛凡尘都目光一凝。
此等手段，当真是神鬼莫测了。
洛凡尘是自信，但也不意味他可以小觑天下英雄。
私底下吹吹牛逼也就算了，真到了战斗的场合，他要比任何人都小心一万倍。
他始终记得，自己身后背负着炎黄大界先辈的期望和栽培，背负着亿万生灵的未来走向何处。
他没有资格浪，而且必须争分夺秒。
洛凡尘思索接下来的行动。
如今上百个黑暗古祖近在咫尺，亿万里的距离对于他们这等修为来说，不过是跨出一步的事情。
远方的不朽长生大界严防死守，根本不给他丝毫进入的机会。
content_en:
"Boom boom boom!"
Luo Fanchen could see that whether it was the purple-gold ocean or the stone monuments that were huge beyond ordinary people's imagination, they all had a powerful aura that could keep away the twenty-level experts.
Behind those huge stone tablets is an immortal realm bathed in purple-gold flames. Judging from the momentum alone, it far exceeds the Yanhuang realm and the mountain and sea realm. Obviously, this immortal realm should be a first-class existence among the nine-dimensional realms.
Behind the blazing purple-gold flames, dozens of huge figures of descendants of the Great Realm could be faintly seen. They were either born in the Immortal Realm, or were strong men who had received news and rushed from other Realms to support them.
Every figure that can stand there and block the figure of the dark ancient ancestor is an unparalleled genius who has defeated the ancient ancestor who invaded his hometown, broke the shackles, and broke through many obstacles. He is a peerless genius who has amazed the entire world.
However, under the invasion of a large number of dark ancestors, they now look extremely embarrassed.
Fengzu said in shock: "That is the legendary triple protection method in the immortal world, the Purple Gold Sea of Immortality, the Eternal Immortal Monument, and the Heaven and Earth Destruction Dao Extreme Fire."
"The three-layer protection method is extremely overbearing. Even if only a few dozen descendants of the great world activate it, it is enough to resist the dark ancestors who are several times their size."
Luo Fanchen nodded, that was indeed the case.
He could clearly feel that it was impossible for him to break through to the immortal world with brute strength alone.
The great world of Yanhuang can create the Supreme Immortal Formation for him to conceal causes and hidden effects. Similarly, the great world of immortality also has its own unique inheritance method.
Feng Zu and others all looked at Luo Fanchen, wondering what the Blood Demon leader would do next.
From their point of view, there is simply no room for the Blood Demon Cult Leader to flourish here.
He couldn't handle hundreds of dark ancestors.
He can't even break through this great realm of immortality.
Even if he could get in, he wouldn't be able to deal with dozens of descendants of the Great Realm.
Luo Fanchen licked his lips: "How about taking the opportunity to rob and kill a few dark ancestors."
Feng Zu turned pale and advised Luo Fanchen not to do this.
"The leader."
"I just missed a dark ancestor."
"The Bloodshed Ancient Ancestor of the twelfth niche of the Dark Heavenly Ancestor is also here."
Luo Fanchen asked: "What's so special about this person?"
Feng Ancestor cast his gaze into the distance, and Luo Fanchen followed his gaze. There were ten huge blood cocoons there, sitting in the rear. It was obvious that the dark ancestors who were arrogant and behaved strangely did not dare to get too close there.
"Leader, those ten blood cocoons should all be the legendary ancient ancestors of blood slough."
"It is rumored that this ancient blood-slaughter ancestor is good at the art of causal parasitism. No one knows how he became parasitic. They only know that many famous dark ancient ancestors, or powerful people in the great world, were quietly parasitized. One day, he suddenly awakened his memory and found that he was the blood-slaughter ancient ancestor."
"These ten blood cocoons are here. I'm afraid there are ten supreme bodies parasitized by the ancient blood-slough ancestors."
The Lord of Mountains and Seas and Luo Fanchen both stared.
These methods are really unpredictable.
Luo Fanchen is confident, but that doesn't mean he can underestimate the world's heroes.
It's okay to brag in private, but when it comes to fighting, he is ten thousand times more careful than anyone else.
He always remembers that behind him is the hope and cultivation of the ancestors of the Yanhuang world, and the future direction of hundreds of millions of creatures.
He is not qualified to wave, and must race against time.
Luo Fanchen thought about his next action.
Nowadays, hundreds of dark ancestors are close at hand, and the distance of hundreds of millions of miles is just one step for their cultivation level.
The great realm of immortality in the distance was tightly guarded and did not give him the slightest chance to enter.
